name: Hòn Tre Cable Car
kicker: The cable crossing to Hòn Tre
summary: The cable is the way onto Hòn Tre. The bureau page prints 3,320 m, an inauguration in March 2007, and calls it the longest sea-crossing cable car in the world at that opening. Vietnam Tourism calls it the longest in Southeast Asia and prints no length. The island is over 3,000 ha on the bureau page and 3,323.15 ha on the bay page.
getThere: The shore station. A ticket price was not printed on the pages used here.
heroCaption: A cabin on the cable, with Hòn Tre and the Vinpearl hillside across the water

notice.title: The length and the ranking are not the same sentence
notice.body: Use 3,320 m from the bureau page. Vietnam Tourism does not print that length. It calls the cable the longest in Southeast Asia. The bureau’s claim is the longest sea crossing at the March 2007 opening.

body: Hòn Tre is the large island in the bay. The bureau page says over 3,000 ha. The provincial bay page, citing the heritage site, says 3,323.15 ha. The cable is 3,320 m on the bureau page, inaugurated in March 2007, and called then the longest sea-crossing cable car in the world. Vietnam Tourism calls the same crossing the longest in Southeast Asia and does not print the metres.

A provincial shopping page for Vinpearl Harbour, opened 26 January 2024 on Hòn Tre in Vĩnh Nguyên, prints cable hours in both directions of 8:30–23:00, with ticket sales stopping at 22:30. After 23:00 until 02:00 it names a speedboat back to shore, the last shore boat at 02:15. A cable fare was not printed on that page. The bay listing hours of 09:00–22:00 are a listing clock, not a beach curfew.

figures.caption: The cable and the island from the same crossing
figures.alt: Another frame of the Hòn Tre cable over the bay

gettingThere: You reach Hòn Tre by the cable from the city shore, or by boat after the cable hours on the Harbour page. Minutes from Trần Phú to the shore station were not printed. The crossing itself is the 3,320 m on the bureau page.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: To the shore station, then the cable. Minutes to the station were not printed.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: The Harbour page names a free bus from the airport to the Hòn Tre pier. It does not print the minutes.

hours: Cable both ways 8:30–23:00 on the Harbour page. Ticket sales stop at 22:30. Last shore boat 02:15.
admissionNote: A fare was not printed on the bureau page or the Harbour page. Check on arrival.
